title: Community Safety Awareness Day Invite
message:
I’m excited to invite everyone to Community Safety Awareness Day at Castlebrook Crossing on September 12 from 4:00–7:00 PM!

We’ll have emergency service vehicles on display, opportunities to meet some of our local first responders, and plenty of time to connect with neighbors and members of the community. The Chosen Juan Mexican Kitchen will also be there with Mexican food and aguas frescas available for purchase.

A big thank-you to Daniela De Armas with Price Mortgage Group for partnering with me to sponsor and host this event.

Please share this post, invite your friends and neighbors, and come spend the afternoon with us! We hope to see you there!
